title: Quality Studio reporting and exports
summary: Decision dossier for a canonical run-scoped report snapshot with self-contained HTML, bounded Markdown for 0-PR pipelines, SARIF 2.1.0 interoperability, JSON truth, and comparable trends across runs. Grounds the recommendation in the current repository-wide report renderer, durable run store, review sidecars, API and CLI routes, frontend run panel, tests, committed sample data, and an actual report command executed on 11 August 2026. Recommends four ordered implementation slices with explicit acceptance evidence.
